hero.discover: Discover our nation's rich history and culture

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Welcome to the official website of the National Federation Empire of Furnovskyland! Here you can learn how to join our Discord and Minecraft servers, and learn about our history, culture, politics, and much more!

history.pageSubtitle: Discover the rich historical heritage of Furnovskyland
history.welcome: Welcome to our Empire! If you are interested, please read this message!

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.content: The Kingdom of Furnovskyland was founded by my coronation on October 31, 2018 at 3pm GMT+2. It was a small city-state, the city of Furnotinyvillage.

expansion.title: Expansion and Wars
expansion.content: We gained a lot of land during a war period that lasted for almost a month. In January 2019, we won the Great Snow World War and gained the south-east corner, some eastern, northern, and south-western areas from the neighbors. After that, we became very good partners with the neighboring German-Hungarian Monarchy, now German-Slovak. From 2020, we are also in a good relationship with the Diamondboy estate (now Land of the Deadbringers) and won their western part of the island for Furnovskyland.

modernEra.title: Modern Era
modernEra.content: We started a very lucky year. Although we had COVID-19, we are now very rich and the economy is growing. On April 15, 2021, for the flag of the Commonwealth, I decided to rename the country to The Empire of the Commonwealth of Furnovskyland and the next government to I. Federal Government of Furnovskyland.

geography.title: Geography
geography.content: We are very rich, but we are in dire need of exports. We have only a small number of hills, only one mountain in the south-east of the country's border with the German-Slovak Monarchy.

government.title: Government
government.content: We have a large district system, currently with 36 and 2 border regions, which are shown on the map. Every major city is divided into 9 parts. Our postcodes are as follows: 1019. This is the postcode of the city centre of the capital. The first 1 is the 1st district. The 01 is the most important city of the district, and 9 is the 9th region of the city.

flag.title: Flag
flag.content: The original was a Hungarian flag (red-white-green tricolor) with an orange dot in the middle. Later it was replaced by a yellow one.

politics.pageSubtitle: Learn about the political system of Furnovskyland

state_structure.title: State Structure
state_structure.content: The state is the Furnovskyland COMMONWEALTH, a constitutional monarchy, with 4 members (Furnovskyland being one) in the Commonwealth, this is not important right now. Currently there is a Government, Senate (both are a mix of legislative and executive) and a court, the Supreme Court. There is no Parliament yet, it will replace the Senate's functions when the Constitution is revised.

legislative_process.title: Legislative Process
legislative_process.intro: The stages of legislation are the following:
legislative_process.organic_law: Organic Law: Creation of an important body or institution, detailed description of its operation.
legislative_process.bill: Bill: A less important institution or concept, with a minor operational description.
legislative_process.decree: Decree: Can only originate from the Emperor or the Government, in the form of any of the above law types, without a vote. However, the Senate may decide to repeal it at any time.
legislative_process.act_submit: Only an Act can be submitted by any resident, the top two can only be submitted by a person elected to one of the branches of power.
legislative_process.step1: The Senate receives the bill, after which the Senator announces a 24-hour discussion period, followed by a (hopefully) 24-hour voting period, which for most laws usually requires a simple majority to pass.
legislative_process.step2: If the Senate accepts it, it goes to the Government, where if it is not accepted by a simple majority, it goes back to the Senate for revision or acceptance within a certain time (I don't know how much now, it's in the Constitution).
legislative_process.step3: If the Government accepts it, it comes to me to either veto it and it goes back to the Government, or I sign it and it becomes law.

senate.title: The Senate
senate.p1: The Senate is elected for 3 months, at the end of every season, with a Single Transferable Vote system, the top 3 candidates get in, the 1st place becomes the Senator, the remaining 2 seats are distributed keeping the vote ratios as close as possible. They take office in the first full week of every new season. The Supreme Judge cannot run. The Senate is basically the first "obstacle" a law has to pass through, and they vote on laws about their own operation, those obviously don't go anywhere else, and they vote on the acceptance of the government list. It has 5 members, each of them is an Observer (the Senator too, they are by default the Discord internal affairs) with currently available positions:

affairs.recruitment: Recruitment affairs (bringing members to the server etc)

senate.p2: The Senator is the one who announces the discussion and voting times (can vote too), records the passed laws in a specific forum channel, officially arranges who will be what Observer (besides their own), appoints a deputy and represents the Senate to the head of state or the government. They can be re-elected for one consecutive term, after that they cannot be elected Senator for 6 months. Observers can comment on a submitted law during the discussion time, vote on them, and cooperate with the ministries closest to them.

executive.title: Executive Power
executive.description: Structure and operation of the executive branch.

supreme_court.title: The Supreme Court
supreme_court.content: The Supreme Court decides on matters of Constitutionality, and things like that, you know. Its members are the Prime Minister, the Minister of Justice, the observer responsible for constitutional affairs and a 4th person, chosen by the prime minister from the list of currently existing judges, appointed by me, and accepted by the Senate with a 2/3 majority.
